name: list-toolbar
title: List Toolbar
description: The one header row of every list and table: the search left, the icon tools (Filter · Sort · Layout · Display · ⋯) right; scope tabs in their own row above and the filter row under it. Measures its own width and collapses in a fixed order.

meta.whenToUse: Above any list, table or board page — scope tabs (their own row), search, filter, sort, layout, display options and view actions. The page's main button is not here: it sits at the right end of the app's top bar.
meta.whenNotToUse: A form's own controls, a record page's header actions (PageHeader), or a picker's inline search (SearchInput).
